hook_line: H-1B WORKERS ARE GIVING UP ON US TECH JOBS AS FEES AND DELAYS PILE UP

hook_stat.sub: Fewer short-term non-immigrant visas issued by the US in the 2025 budget year than the year before

news_summary: Bloomberg profiles Yash Sharma, a 36-year-old Google software engineer from India who is leaving the US for the United Kingdom next month after six years on an H-1B visa, as new charges, PERM suspensions and employer pullbacks stack up.
payoff: Nothing in the reported changes cancels the status of people already holding valid visas — what has changed is the cost and predictability of staying.
